text: No, not all days were fully checked for thermal detections. The first run (run-2) shows all days from October 1–8 as "covered" by all sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21, and MODIS). However, the second run (run-1) reveals that October 8 was "not covered" for any sensor due to delays in near-real-time (NRT) data updates. This means thermal detections could have been missed on October 8. The analysis confirms zero detections for the period, but with incomplete coverage on the last day.
